class.name: OcgBreptoolsModification
class.brief_description: Defines geometric modifications to a shape, i.e. changes to faces, edges and vertices.
class.description: ! Defines geometric modifications to a shape, i.e. ! changes to faces, edges and vertices.

method.name: NewTriangulation
method.description: Returns true if the face has been modified according to changed triangulation. If the face has been modified: - T is a new triangulation on the face

method.name: NewPolygon
method.description: Returns true if the edge has been modified according to changed polygon. If the edge has been modified: - P is a new polygon

method.name: NewPolygonOnTriangulation
method.description: Returns true if the edge has been modified according to changed polygon on triangulation. If the edge has been modified: - P is a new polygon on triangulation
